about: Hand decisions about MA1 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, label}: the printed page, the start of the entry's header, and the sub-block label when the entry has several
verdict   misprint   the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, nothing corrected, and the note says why
table      not a character grid: a generation table; 'block' is its average row, transcribed
label      the OCR mangled a sub-block's label; 'label' is the printed one
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: 4 is Poor. The number is kept, because Health 24 = 4 + 6 + 4 + 10 agrees with it.
4 is Poor. Health 44 = 4 + 10 + 10 + 20 agrees with the number.
30 is Remarkable. Health 110 = 30 + 10 + 20 + 50 agrees with the number.
50 is Amazing. Health 300 = 50 + 50 + 50 + 150 agrees with the number.
R 10 + I 10 + P 10 = 30, and the page prints Karma = 0. Mr. Chambers beside her is the same, so it may be deliberate for Arcade's staff; not corrected.
R 20 + I 6 + P 6 = 32, and the page prints Karma = 0. See Miss Locke.

The Further Morlocks generation table: the AVERAGE column, with columns for rolling each ability below, above or way above it. (V) is the book's 'variable'. F+A+S+E is 38 against the printed 40; the table gives Health as variable, so it is not treated as a misprint.
